items.name: style
items.title: HeroCN style
items.description: HeroUI v3 tokens, radius scale, focus/invalid rings, and pressible motion for shadcn/ui (herocn). Install this first, or add any @herocn/ui item which depends on it.
items.author: Sagar Kemble
items.docs: herocn is MIT-licensed, © 2026 Maqed (github.com/Maqed/herocn). Keep that notice when redistributing. After install, ensure app/globals.css has @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "shadcn/tailwind.css";

@utility pressible.transition: transform 250ms var(--ease-smooth), background-color 100ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 100ms var(--ease-out)

items.name: index
items.title: HeroCN kit
items.description: Installs the HeroCN style, utils, hook, and every UI primitive.
items.author: Sagar Kemble
items.docs:
Add the registry first:

npx shadcn@latest registry add "@herocn=https://herocn.sagarkemble.dev/r/{name}.json"

Then: npx shadcn@latest add @herocn/index
